consensus_summary: Primary meaning across responses is God's Word/Scripture/divine truth as guidance and illumination (Ps 119:105, Prov 6:23, 2 Pet 1:19), with common alternatives of believer/church witness, readiness (ten virgins), lampstands as churches, Holy Spirit, human spirit/conscience, and Davidic lamp; polyvalent and context-driven.
boundary_disagreement: Book restricts exclusively to the commandment (Prov 6:23 language) and omits the broader Word/truth category plus all common alternatives (witness, readiness, churches, Spirit, dynasty, etc.) that consensus treats as attested.
rationale: Cores share the same general referent drawn from the identical Prov 6:23 basis, but the book narrows the primary identification to the single term 'commandment' and presents no other cases, whereas consensus treats 'Word/truth' more broadly and lists multiple extensions; this is boundary refinement rather than replacement or novelty.
strongest_objection: Consensus documents several other frequent, context-specific biblical referents for lamp that the book's sole identification appears to exclude.
